title: pyrus uva-ursi
intro: Pyrus uva-ursi, commonly known as Arbutus unedo, is a small evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region. It is also known as the strawberry tree due to its red, strawberry-like berries. The health benefits of Pyrus uva-ursi include its ability to treat urinary tract infections, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus uva-ursi include arbutin, hydroquinone, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antidiarrheal properties, as well as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
